svg.aria-label: Secant four-stage workflow: capture and rank layers, orthogonalize and calibrate, patch quantized blocks, and lock LoRA updates out of protected directions
svg.text: SECANT · FOUR-STAGE WORKFLOW · GEOMETRY OF EACH STEP
Measure a direction, size an exact edit, write it into stored blocks, and keep later training out of it
Panels marked DATA are drawn from real files (named in the footer); panels marked SCHEMATIC are geometric sketches whose labels quote measured numbers.
Two passes, then an exact step
Q8_0 commutes with Π₁₂₈; Q4_K does not
Projection survives AdamW; masks do not

svg.text: 128 = 4 × 32: every panel is whole blocks, 0 straddles
column 128 splits one superblock: Π₁₂₈ moves half
of its weights away from their shared scales
Π₁₂₈ on panels: π(k·r + j) = j·n_k + k (toy n_k = 2, r = 2)
bytes per block, drawn to one scale
34 B = 2 B f16 d + 32 B int8
144 B = d, dmin (f16) + 12 B scales + 128 B 4-bit q
secant quant patch edits Q8_0 blocks in place and

DATA sources: Stage 1 = layer_snr.json and secant analyze output for SmolLM2-1.7B (peak L12, L_root* = 12); Stage 2 support and Gram-Schmidt numbers = secant compose plan.json (B3, K = 64); Stage 4 ranges and D Dᵀ bound = irrefutable-15models-stage1-receipt.json.
Byte layouts are the ggml block_q8_0 (34 B) and block_q4_K (144 B) structs. The Π₁₂₈ toy uses n_k = 2; Qwen3.5-4B has n_k = 16, r = 2. Geometry in Stages 2 and 4 is a 2D/3D sketch, not to scale.
